question: How do vertical state dimension, state placement, closure resolution and boundary regime jointly control fidelity in the B01 160 cm pure-hydraulics laboratory?

evidence_classes.A1: closure-free future-response state-information replay on immutable Reference futures; partly exposed development evidence
evidence_classes.A2_A2B_A3: teacher-forced operator diagnostics on immutable fixed-flux Reference states; development evidence
evidence_classes.DYN0A: propagated fixed-flux standard-LARE research evidence inherited selectively from work/f-rom-lare-rs1
evidence_classes.C4R_C4S_C4T_C4V: blind/prospective fixed-zero-head groundwater laboratory evidence and same-partition CoRichards controls inherited selectively from work/f-rom-lare-rs1
evidence_classes.BC1: fixed-domain prescribed-head boundary authority and resolution ladder inherited selectively from work/f-rom-lare-rs1

fixed_flux.standard_LARE: less robust than L3; additional domain exits in predecessor DYN0A

fixed_head.note: R2 uniform/coarse comparator exists but is not the active-zone L2 same-partition representation

fixed_flux.interpretation: State information is not the immediate limiter; long-to-local gradient reconstruction is.
Localized fourth storage materially improves closure resolution.

representation_curve.role: fine-grid/no-spatial-reduction control for LARE formulation; Reference Richards remains separate

fixed_head.boundary_time_level_diagnostic: Lagged-K does not remove residual plateau; CURRENT_LAYER_FACE remains physical closure authority.

placement_evidence.B01: Active-lower-zone L2/L3/L4/L6 representations have far fewer state aliases than same-dimension uniform controls in A1.

B14_transfer.interpretation: Placement transfers as a material design axis, but the exact B01 partition is not universalized.

error_separation.state_information_error: A1: largely exhausted by L3 in bounded B01 common cohort; L4/L6 add no demonstrated predictive-state separation there.
error_separation.closure_resolution_error: Fixed-flux DYN0A and A2/A2B/A3: dominant long-to-local gradient/localization error; localized explicit refinement helps far more than a global first moment.
error_separation.numerical_discretization_error: Fixed-head C4S/C4T: same-partition CoRichards converges rapidly with dimension and separates spatial Richards discretization from LARE closure error.
error_separation.high_dimension_fixed_head_floor: LARE R6/R8/R12 bottom-exchange error plateaus while same-partition CoRichards approaches Reference. BC1 shows the plateau is not primarily removed by importing lagged Reference lower-face K timing.

GW-D.evidence: Short-horizon fixed-head comparator-relative frontier begins at dimension 4, but 1.024-day persistence begins at dimension 8.

GW-R.evidence: R8 and R12 are the first tested members with comparator-relative GW crossing persistent across every prospective checkpoint through 1.024 day.

SCI-P.evidence: Profile comparator-relative requirement is stricter against FMC in C4R: minimum crossing dimension 12; against R2 it begins at dimension 4.

AG-WB.evidence: NOT_YET_IN_APPLICATION_ENVELOPE: no ET/root uptake in Phase A.

EVT.evidence: NOT_YET_IN_APPLICATION_ENVELOPE: no infiltration/ponding/runoff event physics in Phase A.

computational_screen.interpretation: Useful cost signal only; no formal or portable speedup claim. Fidelity and cost are not collapsed to one score.

phase_A_adjudication: There is no single minimum layer count independent of boundary regime, horizon and purpose.
For B01, three well-placed storages are a bounded lower bound on predictive state information, but three layers are not a broadly adequate propagated model under the tested closures.
The fourth scalar is more valuable as localized storage resolution near the active interface than as a global first moment over the long layer.
For short fixed-head groundwater response, four targeted layers reach the frozen comparator-relative frontier; for persistence through 1.024 day the frontier moves to eight layers.

At higher dimension, same-partition CoRichards continues to converge while LARE groundwater-exchange error approaches a closure/semantics floor; more layers alone therefore eventually stop buying exchange fidelity.
Absolute application adequacy remains undecided because external purpose tolerances are absent.
next_research_question: Can the fixed-head high-dimension error floor be localized to internal-interface versus prescribed-head operator/model-form terms using teacher-forced Reference states, and does that diagnosis identify a physically justified closure improvement without changing the state representation?
